details.effect: Once per turn, when you play a card that originally costs 5 or more, select an enemy leader or enemy follower on the field. Deal it 3 damage and draw a card.

issues: The trigger is missing the filter 'when you play a card that originally costs 5 or more'. The onCardPlayed ability should restrict to cards with original cost 5 or more.
The target is encoded incorrectly as only the enemy leader. It should target an enemy leader or an enemy follower on the field.
The damage effect should select a single valid target, then deal 3 damage to that selected target before drawing a card.

details.effect: When playing this, [engage] 2 cards on your field named Naterran Great Tree: This costs 2 less to play. ---------- Give your leader [defense]+1. Draw a card.

issues: The 'When playing this, [engage] 2 cards on your field named Naterran Great Tree: This costs 2 less to play' clause is encoded incorrectly as part of the spell's resolving effect. It should be encoded as an optional play-time additional cost that reduces this card's play cost by 2, not as an effect that resolves after the spell is played.

The play-cost reduction is encoded with playCostReduction inside the spell effect, which changes the card after it is already being played. It should instead be represented as a play-time optional cost/payment tied to this card's cost reduction.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [act] [engage]: Select a follower in your cemetery that costs 8 or less. Summon it and change its attack and defense to 1. [lastwords] Banish this.

issues: The activated ability uses tutorFromCemetery to put a card onto the field, but the source text says to select a follower in your cemetery and summon it. It should use summonFromCemetery with filter cardType follower and maxCost 8, count 1, then set the summoned follower's stats to 1/1.
The card incorrectly lists 'lastWords' as a keyword. Last Words should be represented as an ability with timing 'lastWords', not as a keyword.
